model_claims.text: isort previously skipped lines containing a semicolon followed by a comment, but after the fix it no longer skips such lines.
model_claims.source_quote: Fix isort skipping a line whose semicolon is followed by a comment

model_claims.text: After the fix, `import sys; # comment` is discovered as an import and the file is sorted to place `import os` before `import sys # comment`.
model_claims.source_quote: On the branch it finds both imports, reports False, and sorts to `import os\nimport sys  # comment\n`.

model_claims.text: When a line contains a skip directive or honored noqa, the fix preserves the line unchanged instead of rewriting it.
model_claims.source_quote: If a skip directive or honored `noqa` makes the line unsortable, it keeps that line verbatim. This avoids rewriting `import sys; # isort: skip` while preserving ordinary comment attachment.

model_loose_quote_matches.source_quote: On the branch it finds both imports, reports False, and sorts to `import os\nimport sys  # comment\n`.
